=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_semble_contracts.py:17 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `import shutil` is unused in the test file.
  WHY: All reviewers identified it as dead code with no runtime effect.
- agents.md:114-122 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The stable log prefix contract lists `SEMBLE_QUERY` and `SEMBLE_FALLBACK` but omits `SEMBLE_INSTALL` and `SEMBLE_INDEX`.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers noted the missing contractual prefixes, which degrades log-analysis tooling and observability.
- scripts/install_semble.sh:89 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The install script unconditionally writes `SEMBLE_INDEX_AVAILABLE=false` even though index availability is owned by the workflow’s index-build step.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed this is redundant ownership/confusing state management and has no meaningful effect on the intended workflow.
- scripts/install_semble.sh:77-78 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The `grep -Eq "^semble v${SEMBLE_VERSION}$"` version check is brittle and regex-sensitive.
  WHY: Reviewers flagged that it can mis-detect installed versions or force unnecessary reinstalls if `uv tool list` formatting changes.
- scripts/semble_helpers.sh:71-87 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The timestamp capture uses unchecked `python3` subprocesses, so failures can leave empty timestamps and corrupt `elapsed_ms`.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed this can silently break timing telemetry or cause arithmetic errors when `python3` is unavailable.
- tests/test_semble_contracts.py:222-228 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The workflow test uses raw substring assertions against YAML text.
  WHY: Reviewers noted this makes the test brittle to harmless formatting or structural changes.
- scripts/install_semble.sh:109-113 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The successful `uv tool install` output is discarded instead of being preserved or logged.
  WHY: Reviewers identified an observability gap because install warnings and details are lost on the success path.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:536-542 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `continue-on-error: true` on the uv setup step masks setup failures.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed it makes CI look green even when uv setup fails, leaving only downstream fallback logs as evidence.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:409-424 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The fetch loop exits with an error if the Semble support scripts are not present in the upstream mirror.
  WHY: Reviewers flagged that this hard-fails Semble setup when the mirrored source tree is incomplete.
- scripts/semble_helpers.sh:69-70 | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `mktemp` is called without an explicit template.
  WHY: This was reported as a low-confidence portability concern only, with no current runtime failure on the target CI environment.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- tests/test_semble_contracts.py:17 | severity=low | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `import shutil` is imported but nowhere referenced in the file.
  WHY: The import is dead code only; the test suite does not use it.
- agents.md:114-122 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The stable log prefix contract block lists `SEMBLE_QUERY` and `SEMBLE_FALLBACK` but omits `SEMBLE_INSTALL` and `SEMBLE_INDEX`.
  WHY: The missing prefixes are emitted by `scripts/install_semble.sh` and `.github/workflows/implement.yml`, so workflow-log-analysis tooling will not recognize them.
- scripts/install_semble.sh:78 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `grep -Eq "^semble v${SEMBLE_VERSION}$"` treats dots in the version as regex wildcards.
  WHY: A malformed or differently formatted `uv tool list` line could falsely match and make the install check unreliable.
- scripts/semble_helpers.sh:71-87 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The two `python3` timestamp captures do not check subprocess exit status.
  WHY: If `python3` is absent or the heredoc fails, the elapsed-time metric can silently become `0` or otherwise incorrect.
- tests/test_semble_contracts.py:222-228 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The test asserts raw substrings against YAML text.
  WHY: Harmless YAML formatting changes could fail the test even if workflow behavior is unchanged.
- scripts/install_semble.sh:109-113 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The install output is only sanitized on the failure path, so success-path warnings/details are dropped.
  WHY: That leaves a post-install observability gap when `uv tool install` succeeds with warnings.
- scripts/install_semble.sh:89 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `_semble_append_env SEMBLE_INDEX_AVAILABLE false` is written unconditionally at the start of `main()`.
  WHY: The line is always overwritten or skipped later, so it has no effect and blurs ownership of the index-availability flag.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- tests/test_semble_contracts.py:17 | severity=low | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `import shutil` is present but shutil is never used anywhere in the file.
  WHY: Dead code that should be removed for cleanliness.
- agents.md:114-122 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The stable log prefixes contract lists `SEMBLE_QUERY` and `SEMBLE_FALLBACK` but omits `SEMBLE_INSTALL` and `SEMBLE_INDEX`.
  WHY: The contract says the list is used by workflow-log-analysis, so missing prefixes will not be recognized by tooling.
- scripts/install_semble.sh:89 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The install script unconditionally sets `SEMBLE_INDEX_AVAILABLE=false` at the start of `main()`.
  WHY: That flag should be managed by the workflow’s separate index-building step, not by the install script.
- scripts/install_semble.sh:77-78 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The version detection pattern `"^semble v${SEMBLE_VERSION}$"` depends on a specific `uv tool list` format.
  WHY: If `uv` changes its output formatting, the check can fail and trigger unnecessary reinstalls.
- scripts/semble_helpers.sh:71-87 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The helper spawns `python3` subprocesses for timestamp capture with no error handling or fallback.
  WHY: If `python3` is unavailable or fails, the timing path breaks silently and corrupts observability metrics.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:540 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `continue-on-error: true` causes the uv setup step to appear green even when it fails.
  WHY: That makes setup failures harder to diagnose because the failure only surfaces through later fallback behavior.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:409-424 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The fetch loop will exit with an error if `install_semble.sh` or `semble_helpers.sh` are missing from the upstream mirrors.
  WHY: Until the upstream mirror contains those files, consumer repos with `SEMBLE_ENABLED=true` will hard-fail during setup.
- tests/test_semble_contracts.py:222-228 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The test uses raw substring assertions like `"install_semble.sh" in body` on YAML content.
  WHY: Harmless YAML reformatting would cause unrelated test failures.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

  PROBLEM: The helper uses `python3` subprocesses for millisecond timestamps without checking availability or failure.
